channel.title: GN Games News
channel.description: GN Racing GE updates, new cars and modes from GN Games, Georgia.

item.title: Work in progress: real interiors and 20 new wheels
item.description: We're rebuilding every car's cabin at real proportions: period dashboards with live analogue needles for the classics, bucket seats and cages for race cars, modern screens for the newest cars. Also 20 brand-new wheel designs inspired by real tuning culture, each car getting the wheels that fit its body kits. Early work-in-progress previews, not final game graphics.

item.title: What we're building now
item.description: 20 new wheels inspired by real tuning culture, with 5 picks for every car at its real size. Every customizable car is getting the same full body-kit treatment as RETRO 86. And a PC version for Google Play Games is in the works: keyboard, gamepad and fully rebindable controls.

item.title: THUNDER X: five new body kits
item.description: Five packages built from real-world tuning styles: OEM+ SPORT, STREET, WIDEBODY, TRACK GT and EXTREME SHOW. Every package comes with matching wheels that fill the arches.

item.title: RETRO 86: eight tuning packages
item.description: Our free starter car gets the full treatment: GROUP A, DRIFT SPEC, CLUB SPORT and five more packages. New hoods (vented, louvred, real carbon weave), riveted over-fenders, a full carbon diffuser and new wings. Every part can also be fitted on its own.

item.title: Meet KAIZEN: free for everyone
item.description: Our former premium sedan has a new name, and it's free in update 1.4. It gets three new body kits, including a TIME ATTACK kit with a flat front splitter, canards and a 9-fin rear diffuser.

item.title: Three classics join the garage
item.description: RETRO 86, BARON and STRIKER bring the late-80s and 90s to GN Racing GE. RETRO 86 is the new free starter car. Each one gets its own kits, stance and wheel sizes, plus realistic tail lamps.

item.title: Update 1.4: online racing is coming
item.description: Our biggest update so far: live online races and rooms with friends, deeper drift angles and real-physics 360s, full stance, wheel sizes and tuning, xenon lights and your own plate with a neon frame, and a smaller install.
